verdict.rationale: Neon ships a documented CLI and REST API usable non-interactively (API-key auth), plus a GitHub Actions integration for branch-per-PR workflows, and a runtime probe confirms the CLI can be invoked keylessly via npx (`npx -y neon@latest --version`), supporting scripted/CI use. Missing for 10: explicit CI/GitHub Actions workflow YAML examples in the evidence pack and a probe showing authenticated (API-key) command execution in a pipeline context.
